labkit.ui.plot.message

Show a centered empty-state message in an axes.

Syntax

hText = labkit.ui.plot.message(ax, message) hText = labkit.ui.plot.message(ax, message, "Title", titleText)

Inputs

ax
target MATLAB axes or uiaxes handle.
message
user-visible message text owned by the calling app.
Title
optional axes title, default empty.
Color
optional text color, default [0.30 0.30 0.30].

Outputs

hText
text object used for the message.

Related APIs

  • labkit.ui.plot.clampData — Clamp data coordinates inside the visible axes box.
  • labkit.ui.plot.clear — Clear a plot axes before app-owned redraws.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fit — Fit axes limits to finite plotted X/Y data.
  • labkit.ui.plot.fitCanvas — Fit one previewArea axes into a fixed pixel canvas frame.
  • labkit.ui.plot.offsetData — Offset data coordinates by normalized axes fractions.
